hook: Badi table slow? [[Partitioning]] se fast karo

slides.title: Partitioning = [[alvida, badi table]]
points: Badi table ko **chote tukdo** mein baantna
Data ek hi table jaisa dikhta hai
Query sirf **zaroori tukde** pe chalti hai
slides.note: Bole toh: Pura ghar ek sath saaf karne ki jagah, **ek ek room** saaf karna 🧹

slides.title: Date ke hisaab se [[Partition]]
slides.note: Saal ke basis pe data **alag alag files** mein save hoga 🗂️

slides.title: Files ke andar ka [[tukda]]
slides.note: 2024 ki query chalegi toh **sirf p_2024 scan hoga**, baaki ignore! ⚡

slides.title: Range vs [[List]] Partition
slides.note: PostgreSQL aur MySQL dono mein **Hash Partition** bhi hota hai 🔄

slides.title: Purana data [[hatao]]
slides.note: DELETE query chalane se **log table bhar jaati hai**, partition drop karna best hai!

slides.wrong: Partitioning aur Sharding **dono same** hote hain bhai
slides.right: Partitioning = **ek DB** mein tukde. Sharding = **alag servers** par data
slides.why: Table bohot badi ho toh partition, server hi full ho toh shard karte hain 🌐

caption:
Badi table queries slow kar rahi hai? Partitioning use karo bhai 📂

Is post mein:
✅ Partitioning kya hai (chote tukde)
✅ RANGE aur LIST partition
✅ Partition Pruning ka magic
✅ Purana data drop karna super fast
